arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys,importlib.util
req=json.load(open('/tmp/failreq.json'))
sub={"cases":[{"ops":req['cases'][1]['ops'][:101]+[["save"]]}]}
body=json.dumps(sub,separators=(',',':'))
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'run.py'],input=body.encode(),cwd='/workspace',capture_output=True)
resp=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
img=resp['results'][0]['snapshots'][-1]
print('cells',img['cells'],'root',img['root'])
json.dump(img,open('/tmp/img8.json','w'))
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('show','/workspace/tmp/tests/show.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
m.parse(img)
PY
